snippet.title: Athelan Battlegrounds - PvP Turn-based Tactics - Official trailer
snippet.description:
Athelan Battlegrounds is a brand new indie free-to-play Turn-Based Tactics multiplayer game set in a futuristic sci-fi setting. Combining the complexity of chess and the unique champion design of League of Legends, this game promises to be a skill-based PvP experience perfect for those who crave competition!

The game features no pay-to-win mechanics. Developed by 2 people, we want to create and involve a community in the continued development of this game!

The DEMO will be available on Steam in December 2025.

Wishlist us on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3572070/Athelan_Battlegrounds/
